optimizedDescription.value: Language-neutral resolution contract for identifying symbols deterministically across declarations, aliases, public bindings, and hierarchies.

optimizedContext.value:
# resolve-symbol-reference

## Rules

### Input & Identity
- `ResolveSymbolReference` accepts workspace, symbol text, optional constraints (file, public surface, symbol-space, broad kind, member-form, build-context).
- Structured identity authoritative. Rendered canonical references round-trip with escaping, no ad hoc delimiter splitting.
- Identifier case/normalization follow language. Path/workspace normalization separate.

### Canonical Targets
- Return single logical symbol as canonical target, retaining all contributing declaration locations (overloads/merges resolve as 1 target; competing declarations separate).
- Target exposes: workspace, module/package, owner, symbol space, simple name, member form, contributing locations, stable canonical reference (line/column independent).

### Bindings
- Public export slot selected by public surface, exported name, symbol space. Distinct aliases, duplicate re-exports, competing targets remain distinct for ambiguity reporting.
- Local bindings retain lexical scope + source provenance (shadowed aliases non-merged; local alias resolution != public export).
- Anonymous/default exports addressable via public binding identity.

### Precedence
1. Exact declaration in explicitly addressed file/owner
2. Exact public binding in explicitly addressed public surface
3. Statically proven scoped import/alias
4. Statically proven hierarchy path (language rules)
- Same-name symbol without proven path fails resolution. Build-context selects platform/conditional alternatives. Cyclic paths terminate without duplicates.

### Outcomes
- `resolved`: 1 target proven.
- `ambiguous`: multiple valid targets, none selected.
- `unresolved`: proof unsafe/unavailable (stale/dirty/parse-failed/unsupported evidence -> `unresolved`, not `missing`; unknown freshness -> `freshness-unknown`).
- `missing`: current + complete index proves target absent in addressed file/surface.
- Non-resolved includes machine-readable reason code, ordered candidates, typed evidence path.

### Freshness & Coverage
- VCS ref equality insufficient. Call batch `AssessIndexedResourceFreshness` on addressed resources/declaration files. Deduplicate shared inputs. No direct filesystem/hash/repo logic in resolver.
- Exact file-anchored resolution can proceed if file fresh despite global staleness. Workspace-wide fallback/absence/ambiguity requires global completeness; if global stale/unknown -> `unresolved`.

### Hierarchy Members
- Declared/overriding member > inherited member. Contract-qualified -> contract member.
- Traversing ancestor owner queries requested member under ancestor (owner != member). Evidence retains path + ancestor-member declaration.
- Competing inherited members -> `ambiguous`. Getter/setter requires member-form constraint if ambiguous. Implicit interfaces require proven method sets. Bounded cycle termination.

### Batch & Backend
- Batch resolution shares health snapshot + provider lifecycle. Bounded index lookups, no whole-graph scans per query.
- Candidate/provenance ordering, status, reason codes identical across graph backends.

## Constraints
- NO mutation of stored links or sidecars.
- Prohibit fuzzy matching, edit distance, best-guess.
- Runtime reflection, computed imports, monkey patching, unproven value flow -> unresolved.
- Language syntax analysis belongs to language adapters.
